courses.title: AI Fundamentals
courses.blurb: What AI is, and how an intelligent system perceives, decides and acts.

courses.title: Math
courses.blurb: The language of models, from arithmetic to vectors, calculus, probability, statistics, information theory and attention.

courses.title: Machine Learning
courses.blurb: Systems that learn patterns from data instead of being handed every rule: datasets, models, evaluation and the classic algorithms.

courses.title: Deep Learning
courses.blurb: Multi-layer neural networks that learn useful representations themselves.

courses.title: Neural Networks
courses.blurb: Neural computing beyond backpropagation: energy-based memory, biological inspiration, and architectures time passed by.

courses.title: Transformers
courses.blurb: The architecture behind modern generative models: how attention becomes a full block, scales, and specializes.

courses.title: Generative AI
courses.blurb: AI that creates new text, images, audio, video and code: decoding, conditioning, evaluation and the risks of generation itself.

courses.title: LLMs
courses.blurb: Transformers that predict the next token, over and over: how they're trained into instruction-followers, how they reason, and how the field around them works.

courses.title: RAG
courses.blurb: Retrieval-augmented generation: grounding a model in real documents, from chunking and embeddings to retrieval, generation and evaluation.

courses.title: Agents
courses.blurb: Systems that perceive, decide and act using everything before them: planning, tool use, memory, multi-agent coordination, evaluation and safety.
